name: Triangular Arbitrage
summary: This EA implements triangular arbitrage, a market-neutral strategy that exploits price discrepancies between three currency pairs that form a closed loop (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD, EUR/GBP). It continuously monitors bid/ask prices across the three pairs and executes simultaneous trades when a pricing inefficiency exceeds a configurable threshold, aiming to capture risk-free profit from the spread differential.
summary_zh: 该EA实现三角套利策略，通过监控三个形成闭环的货币对（如EUR/USD、GBP/USD、EUR/GBP）之间的价格差异来寻找套利机会。当检测到定价低效超过可配置阈值时，EA会同时执行三个方向的交易，从价差中获取近似无风险的利润。
strategy_analysis: 三角套利策略的核心概念是利用三个相关货币对之间的定价不一致来实现无风险利润。入场条件是当三个货币对的合成汇率与直接汇率之间的偏差超过设定的阈值（考虑交易成本和点差）时，同时买入低估的货币对并卖出高估的货币对。出场条件是在套利价差收敛到零或低于最小盈利目标时平仓，或在持仓时间超过限制时强制平仓。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或根据套利空间动态调整手数，三笔交易的手数需要精确匹配以实现市场中性。资金管理方面，该策略理论上是无方向的，但实际执行中存在滑点、延迟和点差风险，因此需要严格的净盈利阈值过滤。该策略对执行速度要求极高，毫秒级的延迟可能导致套利窗口消失。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of triangular arbitrage is to exploit pricing inconsistencies among three correlated currency pairs to achieve near-risk-free profit. Entry conditions trigger when the deviation between the synthetic cross rate (calculated from the two legs) and the direct quote exceeds a configurable threshold that accounts for trading costs and spreads. The EA simultaneously buys the undervalued pair and sells the overvalued pair, executing all three legs as close together in time as possible. Exit conditions are met when the arbitrage spread converges to zero or falls below a minimum profit target, or when a maximum holding period is exceeded to prevent prolonged exposure. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or dynamically adjusts based on the magnitude of the arbitrage opportunity, with all three trade volumes precisely matched to maintain market neutrality. Money management requires a strict net-profit threshold filter because the theoretical risk-free nature is eroded in practice by slippage, execution latency, and variable spreads. The strategy demands extremely fast execution, as millisecond-level delays can cause the arbitrage window to vanish before all three legs are filled.

pros: 理论上是市场中性策略，不依赖市场方向，无论涨跌均可获利
套利机会在市场波动加剧时更频繁出现，与趋势策略形成互补
逻辑清晰，风险可控，每笔交易都有明确的盈亏预期
无需技术指标判断方向，避免了主观判断带来的情绪干扰
pros_en: Theoretically market-neutral — profits do not depend on market direction, making it resilient in both trending and ranging environments
Arbitrage opportunities increase during volatile periods, providing natural complementarity to trend-following strategies
Clear logic with well-defined profit expectations per trade cycle, making risk assessment straightforward
No reliance on technical indicators for direction, eliminating emotional bias from discretionary signal interpretation
cons: 三角套利窗口极其短暂，对执行延迟极其敏感，在普通零售平台上难以实现
滑点和点差变化可能完全吞噬理论利润，实际净盈利远低于回测结果
三笔交易需要近乎同时成交，如果一条腿成交失败会导致敞口风险
零售经纪商通常对套利行为持负面态度，可能限制账户或加宽点差
cons_en: Arbitrage windows are extremely fleeting — highly sensitive to execution latency, making implementation difficult on standard retail platforms
Slippage and variable spreads can completely erode theoretical profits, resulting in actual net returns far below backtest projections
All three legs must fill nearly simultaneously; a partial fill on one leg creates unwanted directional exposure
Retail brokers typically discourage arbitrage activity and may restrict accounts, widen spreads, or introduce execution delays
improvements: 增加订单执行监控机制，当一条腿未能成交时自动对冲或平仓其余仓位
引入动态点差和延迟估算，实时调整最小利润阈值以适应市场状况
添加WebSocket或更快的价格推送机制，减少价格检测延迟
improvements_en: Add order execution monitoring with automatic hedging or closure of remaining positions when one leg fails to fill
Implement dynamic spread and latency estimation to adjust the minimum profit threshold in real-time based on market conditions
Integrate WebSocket or faster price feed mechanisms to reduce price detection latency

risk_points: 三腿交易的部分成交风险：一条腿未成交会导致单边敞口
执行延迟风险：套利窗口可能在订单提交到成交之间消失
经纪商风险：零售经纪商可能通过重新报价、加宽点差或限制交易来阻止套利
点差波动风险：开仓时的点差与预期不符可能导致亏损
risk_points_en: Partial fill risk across three legs — failure to fill one leg creates unwanted directional exposure
Execution latency risk — the arbitrage window may close between order submission and execution
Broker risk — retail brokers may counter arbitrage through requotes, widened spreads, or trade restrictions
Spread volatility risk — actual spreads at execution may differ from expected, leading to losses
